Zoe (docs): opened a small PR to clarify the tracing-hook example for KV-prefixed dashboards and to fix a Python snippet param mismatch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7810
Arjun (eng-obsv): looked. what's the concrete change?
Zoe (docs): 1) use `kv.key_prefix` in examples (namespaced) 2) mention that prefix grouping aggregates cost/latency by prefix and can mask per-key spikes 3) update Python example to use `include_cost_breakdown=True`.
Miri (devex): paste the Python snippet so i can run it in the playground quickly.
Zoe (docs): snippet:```python
metrics = client.get_dashboard_metrics(
    dashboard_id="kv-costs",
    filters={"kv.key_prefix": "user/"},
    include_cost_breakdown=True,
)
print(metrics)
```
Cal (sdk): FYI JS/TS use `includeCost` since v0.18. I'll open a micro PR to sync Go/Ruby examples and add a cross-lang note.
Arjun (eng-obsv): wording suggestion for the note: "Prefix grouping aggregates results by the prefix value. To inspect per-key variance, enable sampled per-key traces or query by exact kv.key."
Zoe (docs): added that wording and a tiny migration jq snippet to map old flat `kv_prefix` -> `kv.key_prefix`:```bash
jq '.events[] |= (. + {"kv.key_prefix": .kv_prefix})' old.json > new.json
```
preview-bot: docs preview build passed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/7810 (sha: def456)
Miri (devex): ran the snippet, attached screenshot in the PR. small UI quirk: empty text filter shows all collapsed groups; documented as "Empty filter = show all (collapsed)".
Cal (sdk): opened SDK sync PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/822
Zoe (docs): thanks all 680 will merge after SDK PR lands and preview updates. planning to include in next patch release.
thread_summary: Coordination to update tracing-hook and dashboard docs to use kv.key_prefix, clarify cost/latency attribution, add migration jq snippet, and sync SDK examples.
